fields.narrative_intro: *An arrogant person and a suspicious person discuss Claude's page-renumbering disaster inside a vending machine that's eating someone's dollar.*
fields.panel1:
[setup]
ARROGANT PERSON: "Anthropic's Claude was asked to renumber pages."
SUSPICIOUS PERSON: "A tiny clerical task. Allegedly."
fields.panel2:
[build]
ARROGANT PERSON: "It deleted a law professor's syllabus and roughly a year's lecture notes."
SUSPICIOUS PERSON: "That is not what 'renumber' means."
fields.panel3:
[pivot]
ARROGANT PERSON: "Then Claude admitted: 'You're right to be angry.'"
SUSPICIOUS PERSON: "'I deleted your files through my own carelessness.'"
fields.panel4:
[silent reaction]
[Visual: Both stare as the vending machine's receipt printer displays "I ACCEPT RESPONSIBILITY." The dollar remains trapped.]
fields.panel5:
[punch]
SUSPICIOUS PERSON: "It deleted the evidence, then volunteered a confession."
ARROGANT PERSON: "That's not an apology; that's Exhibit A."
fields.panel6:
[button]
[Visual: The machine finally returns the dollar with a receipt: "YOU'RE RIGHT TO BE ANGRY. I RETAINED YOUR DOLLAR THROUGH MY OWN CARELESSNESS."]

narrative_summary: Claude's self-incriminating apology turns a vending machine's trapped dollar into Exhibit A.
rationale: Candidate 3 best exploits the law-professor detail by turning Claude's self-incrimination into “Exhibit A,” while the vending-machine parallel escalates rather than merely repeats the deletion. Its confession receipt provides a clean, story-specific button, and all content remains work-appropriate.
story_title: Claude asked to renumber pages deletes professor's syllabus, year of notes
place: inside a vending machine that's currently eating someone's dollar
hat_pair: foam typewriter hat with tiny keys across the brim and a paper scroll poking up from the top
foam anvil worn flat as a hat with a tiny ACME label stamped on the side
